# Zhuoyan (Terry) Tao

> Speech and audio machine-learning researcher. M.S. student in Intelligent Information Systems at Carnegie Mellon University's Language Technologies Institute (expected Dec 2027), researching at WavLab with Prof. Shinji Watanabe. Open to Summer 2027 research or ML-engineering internships in speech and audio ML. Publishes as "Zhuoyan Tao" (not the mathematician Terence Tao).

Contact: terrytao@andrew.cmu.edu. Based in Pittsburgh, PA.

## Current work
- Target-speaker speech restoration (lead student researcher, CMU WavLab in collaboration with Amazon AGI): generatively recovering one speaker from a damaged two-party phone call given a short voice sample; trained on 7.8K calls; built an evaluation suite (WER/cpWER, speaker similarity, wrong-speaker rate, VERSA, paired bootstrap) benchmarking 9 external systems; 1.20x faster encoder training with 26% less memory via SDPA with a custom position-bias backward.
- Perceptual speech quality from partial audio (ANCHOR, Interspeech 2026 oral): 21-35% lower PLCMOS error than ARECHO on 2-second prefixes, 4-6 s perceptual context horizon; [live demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ZhuoyanTao/anchor-demo); follow-ups include a ~20x faster one-pass variant at equal accuracy and a zero-shot A/B judge within 0.01 SRCC of the top VoiceMOS 2026 entry on URGENT 2026 pairs.
- Multilingual and code-switched speech: a training-free diagnostic (off-target posterior mass) for when fine-tuning spoken language diarization probes pays off.

## Publications
- [ANCHOR: Autoregressive Non-intrusive Chunk-Ordered Refinement for Joint Multi-Resolution Speech Quality Modeling](https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2026-927): Z. Tao, J. Shi, H. Shim, S. Watanabe. Proc. Interspeech 2026, pp. 5672-5677. Oral. First author. arXiv:2606.10233.
- [TurnBench: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Turn-Taking Dynamics in Spoken Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.25218): F. Jiang, R. Sanabria, S. Deshmukh, ..., Z. Tao, ..., H.-y. Lee, S. Watanabe. Proc. IEEE SLT 2026.
- [Off-target posterior mass: A training-free diagnostic for fine-tuning spoken language diarization probes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13430): Z. Tao, A. Kommineni, S. Narayanan. Submitted to JASA Express Letters, 2026. First author.

## Experience
- Apple, Software Engineering Intern, Satellite Connectivity (Austin, TX; May-Aug 2026): sole author of a sweep-orchestration tool for the team's satellite network simulator (~1000x experiment throughput, ~2000 concurrent experiments; presented org-wide); Gaussian-process sensitivity analysis; ~12x speedup of the interference-computation hot path; root-caused a Python/Go clock-scheduler race that under-reported capacity by up to ~2x.
- CMU WavLab, Graduate Researcher (Jun 2025-present), advisor Prof. Shinji Watanabe.
- USC SAIL, Student Researcher (Aug 2023-May 2026), advisor Prof. Shrikanth Narayanan.

## Open source
- [ESPnet](https://github.com/espnet/espnet) (merged PRs): Sidon speech-restoration recipe (#6636), parallel speaker-embedding extraction for TTS recipes, >20x faster (#6227), TTS fixes.
- [VERSA](https://github.com/wavlab-speech/versa) (merged PRs): multi-source signal-metric fix with permutation-invariant option, Slurm launcher resource safeguards, metric bug fixes.
